mn134:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
mn134:1.3: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Lomasakaṅgiyo Sakkesu viharati Kapilavatthusmiṃ Nigrodhārāme.
mn134:2.1: Atha kho Candano devaputto abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappaṃ Nigrodhārāmaṃ obhāsetvā yen' āyasmā Lomasakaṅgiyo ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. Ekamantaṃ thito kho Candano devaputto āyasmantaṃ Lomasakaṅgiyaṃ etad avoca:
mn134:2.2: Dhāresi tvam, bhikkhu, Bhaddekarattassa uddesañ ca vibhaṅgañ cāti?
mn134:2.3: Na kho ahaṃ, āvuso, dhāremi Bhaddekarattassa uddesañ ca vibhaṅgañ ca.
mn134:2.4: Tvaṃ pan', āvuso, dhāresi Bhaddekarattassa uddesañ ca vibhaṅgañ cati?
mn134:2.5: Aham pi kho, bhikkhu, na dhāremi Bhaddekarattassa uddesañ ca vibhaṅgañ ca.
mn134:2.6: Dhāresi pana tvaṃ, bhikkhu, Bhaddekarattiyo gāthā ti?
mn134:2.7: Na kho ahaṃ, āvuso, dhāremi bhaddekarattiyo gāthā.
mn134:2.8: Tvam pan' āvuso, dhāresi Bhaddekarattiyo gathā ti?
mn134:2.9: Dhāremi kho 'ham, bhikkhu, Bhaddekarattiyo gāthā ti.
mn134:2.10: Yathākatham pana tvaṃ, āvuso, dhāresi Bhaddekarattiyo gāthā ti?
mn134:2.11: Ekamidaṃ, bhikkhu, samayaṃ Bhagavā devesu Tāvatiṃsesu viharati Pāricchattakamūle Paṇḍukambalasilāyaṃ.
mn134:2.12: Tatra Bhagavā devānaṃ Tāvatiṃsānaṃ Bhaddekarattassa uddesañ ca vibhaṅgañ ca abhāsi:
mn134:4.1: Evaṃ kho ahaṃ, bhikkhu, dhāremi Bhaddekarattiyo gāthā.
mn134:4.2: Uggaṇhāhi tvaṃ, bhikkhu, Bhaddekarattassa uddesañ ca vibhaṅgañ ca;
mn134:4.3: pariyāpuṇāhi tvaṃ, bhikkhu, Bhaddekarattassa uddesañ ca vibhaṅgañ ca;
mn134:4.4: dhārehi tvaṃ, bhikkhu, Bhaddekarattassa uddesañ ca vibhaṅgañ ca;
mn134:4.5: atthasaṃhito, bhikkhu, Bhaddekarattassa uddeso ca vibhaṅgo ca ādibrahmacariyako ti.
mn134:5.1: Atha kho āyasmā Lomasakaṅgiyo tassā rattiyā accayena senāsanaṃ saṃsāmetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya yena Sāvatthī tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
mn134:5.2: Anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena Sāvatthī Jetavanaṃ Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāmo yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Lomasakaṅgiyo Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
mn134:5.3: Ekamidaṃ, bhante, samayaṃ Sakkesu viharāmi Kapilavatthusmiṃ Nigrodhārāme.
mn134:5.4: Atha kho, bhante, aññataro devaputto abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappaṃ Nigrodhārāmaṃ obhāsetvā yenāhaṃ ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. Ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho, bhante, so devaputto maṃ etad avoca:
mn134:5.5: Dhāresi tvaṃ, bhikkhu, Bhaddekarattassa uddesañ ca vibhaṅgañ cāti?
mn134:5.6: Evaṃ vutte ahaṃ, bhante, taṃ devaputtaṃ etad avocaṃ:
mn134:5.7: Na kho ahaṃ, āvuso, dhāremi Bhaddekarattassa uddesañ ca vibhaṅgañ ca.
mn134:5.28: Sādhu me, bhante, Bhagavā Bhaddekarattassa uddesañ ca vibhaṅgañ ca desetūti.
mn134:6.1: Jānāsi pana tvaṃ, bhikkhu, taṃ devaputtan ti?
mn134:6.2: Na kho ahaṃ, bhante, jānāmi taṃ devaputtan ti.
mn134:6.4: Candano, bhikkhu, devaputto aṭṭhikatvā manasikatvā sabbaṃ cetaso samannāharitvā ohitasoto dhammaṃ suṇāti.
mn134:6.5: Tena hi, bhikkhu, suṇāhi sādhukaṃ manasikarohi, bhāsissāmīti.
mn134:6.6: -Evaṃ bhante ti kho āyasmā Lomasakaṅgiyo Bhagavato paccassosi.
mn134:8-13.1: Kathañ ca, bhikkhu, atītaṃ anvāgameti? Evaṃrūpo ahosiṃ atītam addhānan ti tattha nandiṃ samanvāneti; evaṃvedano ahosiṃ --pe--; evaṃsañño ahosiṃ --pe--; evaṃsaṃkhāro ahosiṃ --pe--; evaṃviññāṇo ahosiṃ atītam addhānan ti tattha nandiṃ samanvāneti. --
mn134:8-13.3: Kathañ ca, bhikkhu, atītaṃ nānvāgameti? -- Evaṃrūpo
mn134:8-13.12: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhu, paccuppannesu dhammesu na saṃhīrati.
mn134:14.18: Attamano āyasmā Lomasakaṅgiyo Bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandīti. 135.
